title: Identify operating, investing, and financing activities, and the statement of cash flows format

items.concept: Classify O/I/F cash flows; initial recognition and disposal/settlement JEs; period-end adjusting JEs (interest accrual, dividend declaration) with no SCF cash; cash reconciliation schedule; formal SCF format
Number-variant twin: classify O/I/F; PPE purchase, disposal with loss, stock/debt issue, principal settlement; period-end interest accrual; cash rollforward and SCF cash definition

Period-end adjusting JEs vs cash settlements; cash+equivalents+restricted cash total; edge classifications (trading securities, finance-lease principal, noncash land-for-note); building disposal and bond maturity; reverse solve beginning cash; gross presentation
Classification of cash interest vs accrual and dividends paid; full PPE sale proceeds as investing inflow
